Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
This is another general question, using a specific example.
Praxis Seizure: Stockholm says that if the Prince is a
Malkavian, he gains +1 Capacity.

1) If the vampire already had this title (i.e. Greger
Anderssen calling this vote, or someone else who has already
passed PS: Stockholm), does he still gain the +1 Cap even if
his title doesn't change?
1a) What if the vote is called multiple times?
(Greger calls Praxis Seizure Stockholm on himself 3 turns
in a row, and it passes each time. Does he gain +3
Capacity?)

2) If the vampire _loses_ the title, does he lose the +1 Cap?

Thanks again.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:
> This is another general question, using a specific example.
> Praxis Seizure: Stockholm says that if the Prince is a
> Malkavian, he gains +1 Capacity.
>
> 1) If the vampire already had this title (i.e. Greger
> Anderssen calling this vote, or someone else who has already
> passed PS: Stockholm), does he still gain the +1 Cap even if
> his title doesn't change?

Yes.
He loses his old title and gains the new (same) title, plus
the capacity-increasing-clan-based-effect.

> 1a) What if the vote is called multiple times?
> (Greger calls Praxis Seizure Stockholm on himself 3 turns
> in a row, and it passes each time. Does he gain +3
> Capacity?)

No. When he loses the capacity-bestowing title, he loses the
capacity bestowed.

> 2) If the vampire _loses_ the title, does he lose the +1 Cap?

Yes.
